descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Winter Orange' Rare Winter Orange Coral Bark Winter Interest Japanese Maple Zones 6-9 'Winter Orange' is a new selection of winter interest Japanese maple that displays bright orange bark during the winter. The small green leaves on 'Winter Orange' turn bright yellow to orange in the fall. 'Winter Orange' is a vigorous grower, putting on quite a bit of growth at an early age. 'Winter Orange' may reach 12-14 ft in 10 years. 'Winter Orange' is a selection from Canada and is rumored to be extremely cold tolerant, as many claim that it was selected from a much colder zone, where many Japanese maples, especially coral bark Japanese maples, would not typically grow. Give 'Winter Orange' protection from the hot afternoon sun, with some morning sunlight to peak the intensity of the color of the orange bark.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Winter Orange' 稀有冬季橙色珊瑚皮日本枫，冬季观赏型，适生区 6-9。'Winter Orange' 是一款较新的冬季观赏型日本枫选育品种，冬季树皮呈鲜亮橙色。其小型绿色叶片在秋季转为明亮的黄色至橙色。'Winter Orange' 生长势强，幼年期生长量较大。10 年内可长至 12-14 英尺。'Winter Orange' 为加拿大选育品种，据称极耐寒，很多人认为它选自更寒冷的地区，而多数日本枫，尤其是珊瑚皮类日本枫，通常难以在那样的区域生长。在炎热地区，建议避开午后烈日，并给予一定的晨光，以增强橙色树皮的显色效果。
